heading: Ways we can work together
intro: Support for anxiety, relationship concerns, past experiences, and life's transitions — wherever you're starting from. Sessions are available in person and via telehealth.

cards.title: Individual Therapy
cards.text: For anxiety, life transitions, and the effects of past experiences — a space to better understand yourself and move toward the life you want.

cards.title: Couples Therapy
cards.text: For partners navigating relationship concerns and disconnection — rebuilding understanding, communication, and closeness.

cards.title: Family Therapy
cards.text: For families working through patterns that leave everyone feeling stuck — creating a home where every voice is heard.

faithText: For clients who wish to incorporate their faith into the counseling process, I am happy to integrate faith-based perspectives and beliefs in a way that feels meaningful and authentic to them.
ctaText: Reach out to ask about availability, rates, and how to schedule your first session.
